verdict.rationale: OpenAI publishes a standing deprecations page tracking dated shutdowns with recommended replacements, and the changelog explicitly points to it for upcoming deprecations, alongside versioned model naming (e.g. gpt-4-32k to gpt-4o migration guidance) and a migration guide for API surface changes (Chat Completions to Responses). This directly matches the story of relying on versioned APIs with documented deprecation policy. Missing for 10: no independent/community corroboration of how deprecation timelines play out in practice, and no explicit SemVer-style versioning scheme for the API itself beyond model-level deprecations.
